# SylviaLab — Heeju Kang (강희주)

> SylviaLab is the teaching and advisory practice of Heeju Kang (강희주). It covers AI product design, product strategy, vibe coding and localization — taught the way they are used on real projects in Korea and abroad. Offerings: live-cohort AI bootcamps, two-hour live AI workshops, a global-career portfolio bootcamp, 1:1 cross-border career advisory, team training, and a SKILL.md kit for Korean-user prototyping. Based in Seoul. The site is bilingual: Korean at https://sylvialab.kr/ and English at https://sylvialab.kr/en/.

## About Heeju Kang

- Mentor and instructor for AI product design and strategy, with experience on both the Korean and global sides of product.
- Career: IBM (consulting), KB Kookmin Bank (service planning), Korbit (marketing & strategy), a #1 exchange business (raised investment), Hongik University IDAS (PhD candidate, Human-Robot Interaction).
- 400+ career mentees. Talks at TOKEN2049, Devcon, IVS Kyoto. Classes at Kookmin University, Hongik University, and NHN.
- Contact: heejuk@mail.hongik.ac.kr · Writing: https://brunch.co.kr/@sylviasolution/

## What SylviaLab offers

- **AI bootcamps** (live cohorts) — AI Product Strategy (3 weeks), AI Product Design (4 weeks), Vibe-Coded Prototypes (4 weeks), Global Product Localization (4 weeks). https://sylvialab.kr/bootcamps.html
- **AI workshops** (2 hours, live & hands-on) — e.g. prototyping with Claude while keeping a design system, adapting a global product for Korean users, shipping a first screen with vibe coding. https://sylvialab.kr/workshops.html
- **Career bootcamp** — Portfolio bootcamp for global roles; rewrite Korean experience for global hiring managers and finish one case study (4 weeks). https://sylvialab.kr/career.html
- **1:1 career advisory** — Korea ↔ global career decisions, one to one. https://sylvialab.kr/advisory.html
- **Team training** — AI & UX training for product teams (workshop, 4-week team cohort, or talk). https://sylvialab.kr/team.html
- **SKILL.md kit** — SKILL.md files that teach AI tools how Korean users work, for Claude or Figma Make ($19). https://sylvialab.kr/kit.html

- Teaching or mentoring on AI product design, AI prototyping, vibe coding, and product localization for Korean users.
- Career guidance for people moving between Korea and global product roles (either direction).
- Corporate or team AI & UX training, and talks on AI in product work.
